propositions: Rebar must safely delegate credential issuance, retrieval, persistence, refresh, rotation, and invalidation to upstream SDKs, credential helpers, CI/deployment platforms, and AWS workload identity rather than implementing a universal secret broker

Current defect: _bridge_runner copies full parent environment to reconciler and ticket delivery, exposing unrelated Jira/LLM/cloud credentials; RP-04 must replace with adapter-owned baseline plus only selected auth capabilities
Static-secret rotation for long-running processes requires restart or redeploy; Rebar will not poll environment, watch files, or maintain hot-reload secret cache

Initial public Python seam accepts provider-native credential/identity/session capabilities into Rebar-owned factories but not arbitrary fully constructed SDK clients that could bypass Rebar retry/timeout/cache/output/lifecycle policy
Unavoidable static credentials use Pydantic SecretStr/SecretBytes only in provider-specific non-serializable containers with fields excluded from repr/comparison/hashing/caching/fingerprints

Subprocess environment should preserve ambient inheritance for trusted same-capability children, avoid mutating global os.environ, overlay Rebar-materialized values only onto their owning child, and remove Rebar-declared secret variable names from unrelated siblings
